title: Malicious code in global-error-handling (npm)
description: The global-error-handling npm package versions 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 include malicious code that executes automatically upon installation. This code collects the installer's machine hostname and current working directory and sends this information to a third-party public webhook service unrelated to the package publisher. This behavior constitutes unsolicited data exfiltration during the package's postinstall script execution.
